description: Beam-width convergence check of the SARS-CoV-2 genome's ensemble free energy (Gensemble), reproducing the same diagnostic used in LinearCapR's Figure 7 (Otagaki2026-ev) but under the raccess-compatibility engine (Turner 1999) to match this paper's accuracy evaluation (Results §3.1-§3.2), rather than the lincapr/Turner 2004 settings used for the runtime/memory scaling in §3.3. Supports the new Results §3.3 figure (fig:sars_convergence).

linracc.note_on_revision: This commit (59b692c, child of bbba4549) adds the -print-ensemble-energy CLI flag used to generate this evidence; it changes only linracc_main.cpp (a new opt-in output flag, exposing the pre-existing LinCapR::get_energy_ensemble() method), so no previously-frozen evidence is affected. Binary rebuilt from a verified-clean checkout at this commit before running (no -dirty suffix).

note: An earlier attempt at this experiment (same day) mistakenly passed an explicit -source-revision=bbba4549... flag while the binary was actually built from a dirty working tree (bbba4549 + the uncommitted -print-ensemble-energy diff), which would have falsely recorded a clean revision. That attempt's output was discarded (not committed) once caught; this bundle was regenerated from a properly committed, clean checkout (commit 59b692c) with auto-detected revision embedding.
